_provenance:
The Add Library dialog's settings form: GET /library/sections/prefs?type=<N>&agent=<id> for every library type and agent, captured 2026-09-14 from the 1.42.2 reference (Plex 1.42.2 -- the build rex reports) with plexlab (1.43.4) as the second witness. `lists["<type>"]` is the list with no agent, a legacy agent or an unknown one; `lists["<type>|<agent>"]` is where an agent changes it. Every setting has one definition across all lists, so each is stored once with its NEW-library default.

Cycle 18: this is the FOURTH fixture found to be per VERSION, after Meta.Type[].Filter (cycle 14), Meta.Type[].Field and system_agents.json (cycle 17). It was captured off plexlab and differs from the 1.42.2 reference in 16 of 35 (type, agent) cells. On 1.42.2 the AGENT's own settings are appended whatever the type= is, so type=9&agent=tv.plex.agents.movie answers the movie agent's 12 settings where 1.43.4 answers only `hidden`; and on 1.43.4 tv.plex.agents.none and .music add five or six generic rows at types 1 and 2 that 1.42.2 does not have, which is the cell the Add Library dialog's own "Personal Media" choice reaches. `useSeasonTitles` belongs to the SERIES AGENT on 1.42.2 and to the SHOW TYPE on 1.43.4. Every setting's own attributes -- type, default, label, summary, enumValues, hidden, advanced, group -- are identical on both versions: 0 differences over 35 settings.

enableBIFGeneration.summary: Make video preview thumbnails for this library's items, if server settings have this turned on.

collectionMode.label: Collections

enableVoiceActivityGeneration.label: Enable voice activity detection
enableVoiceActivityGeneration.summary: Find voice activity for this library's items, if server settings have this turned on. Subtitle auto-sync needs it.

originalTitles.label: Use original titles
originalTitles.summary: Show every item's original title, whatever the library language is.

localizedArtwork.label: Artwork in the library's language
localizedArtwork.summary: Pick posters in the library's language when there are any. The library language setting decides which.

useLocalAssets.label: Use local assets
useLocalAssets.summary: Use posters and artwork found next to the media when scanning this library.

respectTags.label: Prefer local metadata
respectTags.summary: Favour embedded tags and local files, if there are any, when scanning this library.

useExternalExtras.label: Find extras
useExternalExtras.summary: Look up trailers and extras on their own (Plex Pass required)

skipNonTrailerExtras.label: Only show trailers
skipNonTrailerExtras.summary: Leave out any extras that are not trailers

useRedbandTrailers.label: Allow red band trailers
useRedbandTrailers.summary: Pick red band (restricted audiences) trailers if there are any

includeExtrasWithLocalizedSubtitles.label: Localized subtitles
includeExtrasWithLocalizedSubtitles.summary: Also include extras that have subtitles in the Library language

includeAdultContent.label: Allow matching to explicit content
includeAdultContent.summary: Let items match adult/pornographic titles and show adult titles in fix match results. Such titles may be left out of features like your Watchlist.

autoCollectionThreshold.label: Minimum automatic collection size
autoCollectionThreshold.summary: Make a collection on its own once an available collection has at least this many items. Changing the number leaves existing collections as they are.

ratingsSource.label: Ratings Source
ratingsSource.summary: Pick the main source of ratings.

showOrdering.label: Episode ordering
showOrdering.summary: The episode naming scheme used by the files on disk.

episodeSort.label: Episode sorting
episodeSort.summary: Order in which a show's episodes are listed.

enableIntroMarkerGeneration.label: Enable intro detection
enableIntroMarkerGeneration.summary: Find intros and offer intro skipping for this library's items, if server settings have this turned on.

useSeasonTitles.label: Use season titles
useSeasonTitles.summary: Show season titles if there are any.

albumSort.label: Album sorting
albumSort.summary: Order in which an artist's albums are listed.

enableTrackOffsets.label: Store track progress
enableTrackOffsets.summary: Pick up where you stopped listening last time. Handy for libraries of long audio.

augmentWithSharedContent.label: Include related content from shared libraries
augmentWithSharedContent.summary: Add suggestions and more albums from libraries others share with you, and mix shared tracks into Artist Radio.

artistBios.label: Artist Bios
artistBios.summary: Fetch artist biographies from the cloud.

albumReviews.label: Album Reviews and Critic Ratings
albumReviews.summary: Fetch album reviews and critic ratings from the cloud. They may change how you feel about your music taste.

popularTracks.label: Popular Tracks
popularTracks.summary: Fetch popular track data, used for radio stations and the popular tracks section.

useExternalLyrics.label: Find Lyrics
useExternalLyrics.summary: Look up lyrics for this library's tracks on their own.

concerts.label: Concerts
concerts.summary: Fetch artists' concert data, should you ever go out.

genres.label: Genres
genres.summary: Where artist and album genres are fetched from automatically.

albumPosters.label: Album Art
albumPosters.summary: Where album covers are fetched from automatically.
albumPosters.enumValues: 2:Plex Music Only|3:Local Files Only|1:Both Plex Music and Local Files
